worker-removal.title: Delete Worker?
worker-removal.consequence: This Worker will lose access to this server and be removed from saved runner devices.
worker-removal.retained: Session history and files on the device will be kept. Running work may require recovery.
worker-removal.protected: This app's current local Worker cannot be deleted.
worker-removal.identityPending: Checking which Worker belongs to this app. Deleting is unavailable until the check finishes.
worker-removal.identityUnavailable: This app could not verify its current local Worker, so Workers cannot be deleted right now.
worker-removal.guardUnverified: This app could not verify its current local Worker, so this Worker was not deleted. Retry verification and confirm again.
worker-removal.capabilityPending: Checking whether this server supports deleting Workers.
worker-removal.capabilityUnknown: Could not check whether this server supports deleting Workers, so deleting is unavailable.
worker-removal.unsupported: This server does not support deleting Workers. Update the server to enable deletion.
worker-removal.schemaUnsupported: This Worker record uses a format this app version cannot delete.
worker-removal.deleted: Deleted Worker {{v0}}. Its session history and device files were kept.
worker-removal.stale: This Worker changed after the confirmation opened. Review its current state and confirm again.
worker-removal.alreadyRemoved: This Worker was already removed. Refresh Runner Devices.
worker-removal.uncertain: The result of deleting this Worker is unknown. Retry the original request to recover its result; no new request will be sent.
